t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The orange, red, green and blue gnomes will lead me to the bright forest. The other gnomes will lead me to the dark forest. One of these forests will have the most mushrooms but this will change several times throughout the game. The hats and positions of the gnomes makes no difference to the number of mushrooms in a forest.

vb_textbox.text: I have some advice for you my friend. When choosing the gnome you should ignore everything about them apart from their colour. The gnomes coloured RED, BLUE, GREEN and ORANGE will take you to a forest where you will have a red basket.The gnomes that appear in any other will take you to a forest where you will have a yellow basket.Sometimes the the forest with the red basket will contain the most mushrooms.Sometimes the forest with the yellow basket will contain the most mushrooms.Stay with either the red basket or the yellow basket for as long as you are collecting a good amount of mushrooms.When the amount of mushrooms drops to 1 or 0 I advise you to switch to the other colour basket by choosing the appropriate colour of the gnome.This is my advice to help you to collect as many mushrooms as possible.
